en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup>

was asked about a son of the raped woman, the man having fabricated against her, so he was saying, ‘O son of the (sexually) active’. So heasws said: ‘Iasws view that upon him is the Penalty (Hadd) of eighty lashes, and he should repent to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic from what he said’.
